title: SimulatorOperation
description: One processing operation as the processing simulator records it: the authoritative fictional record (URS Section 3.4). Returned by every simulator call, by the status query and in simulator notifications. Never contains a card number or security code. Rules are in SIMULATOR-CONTRACT.md.

operation_id.description: Generated by the gateway and stored before the call. The simulator holds at most one record per operation_id (FR-SIM-03).

status.description: approved and declined are final outcomes. no_record means the simulator never received the operation before a status query asked for it; the operation_id is now retired and a late arrival is rejected with 409 operation_retired (FR-SIM-03, UC-28). A record never changes status once written.

decline_reason.description: Set only when status is declined.

merchant_id.description: Gateway merchant ID, for scoping and reconciliation reports. null on a no_record entry.

payment_id.description: Gateway payment ID. null on a no_record entry.

authorisation_id.description: For capture, cancel and refund: the operation_id of the authorisation they act on. null for authorise and for no_record.

refund_id.description: Gateway refund ID, for refund operations only.

amount.description: Cents. Authorised, captured or refunded amount as requested; for cancel, the amount released. null on a no_record entry.

card.description: Brand and last four digits, authorise only. The simulator never stores the full number or the security code.

simulator_reference.description: The simulator's own record ID, quoted as evidence in reconciliation and the audit log. null on a no_record entry.

authorisation.description: Current state of the authorisation this operation belongs to, at the time of the reply (it can change later; the operation itself cannot). null for a declined authorise and for no_record.

captured_amount.description: 0 until captured. May be less than authorised_amount (partial capture); the rest was released.

network.description: v2: how the operation crossed the SecurePay Network, acquirer to switch to issuer (NETWORK-CONTRACT.md). null for no_record, for a capture, cancel or refund the acquirer declined on its own rules (never sent), and for records made before v2. Never contains the card number.

recorded_at.description: When the record was committed. For no_record, when the status query retired the operation_id.

type.description: The type the status query asked about, if given; otherwise authorise.

auth_code.description: Issuer's authorisation code (DE 38), approved authorisations only.

trace.description: One hop per node the message reached, acquirer first.

DeclineReason.description: insufficient_funds, card_declined, expired_card and issuer_unavailable come from the issuer's response code (authorise; NETWORK-CONTRACT.md section 6). The rest are the simulator's own checks on capture, cancel and refund; the gateway checks the same rules first, so seeing one means the two records disagree and reconciliation should flag it.
